name: HAT
variant: HER2Match author cases · canonical published model · seed42
configuration:
seed: 42
study: her2match_complete_20261123_hat_HER2Match_HER2
output_dir: <local path>
data:
  task: breast_he_to_ihc
  root: <local path>
  train_manifest: train.csv
  val_manifest: val.csv
  test_manifest: test.csv
  marker: HER2
  datasets:
  - HER2Match
  crop_size: 256
  geometry: physical_resolution
  target_mpp: 0.46
  identity_protocol: her2match_author_cases_v1
  workers: 4
  validation_workers: 4
  persistent_workers: false
  timeout: 0
  sampling: uniform
loss:
  l1: 1.0
  ssim: 0.0
  edge: 0.0
train:
  max_steps: 80000
  batch_size: 4
  lr: 0.0001
  amp: bf16
  max_seconds: 2700
  checkpoint_every: 1000
  validate_every: 2000
  log_every: 50
  warmup_steps: 500
  l1_priming_steps: 0
  grad_clip: 1.0
  validate_initial: false
  schedule: cosine
  until_plateau: true
  reference_steps_per_epoch: 725
validation:
  lpips: true
  fp32: true
  unpadded: true
  selection_metric: lpips
  selection_mode: min
  aggregation: tile_mean
  weights: online
  early_stopping:
    enabled: true
    patience: 8
    min_delta: 0.0001
    warmup_steps: 10000
    warmup_checks: 5
    warmup_epochs: 5
model:
  name: hat_l
  in_channels: 3
  image_size: 256
  window_size: 16
  embed_dim: 180
  depths:
  - 6
  - 6
  - 6
  - 6
  - 6
  - 6
  - 6
  - 6
  - 6
  - 6
  - 6
  - 6
  num_heads: 6
  checkpoint_groups: true
  drop_path_rate: 0.1
  stem: direct

  status: production
  manifest_sha256:
    train: 6c8cb9f704e5df8062b15c78b1d6226569e46dd7e24fcb919dbbcf6869fe7cb2

  identity: her2match_author_cases_v1
  selection: minimum full validation LPIPS; test never selects weights
  direction: he_to_ihc
  marker_conditioning: single_marker
